English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem participant-role

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/participant-role defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
gateway GatewayAn intermediary that bridges between networks or domains (e.g., XCA gateway, national contact point).
broker BrokerA routing or orchestration intermediary (e.g., message broker, integration engine, central services hub).
proxy ProxyA transparent intermediary acting on behalf of the initiator or responder.
observer ObserverAn actor that receives information about the interaction without affecting it (e.g., audit repository).
authz-server Authorization ServerAn actor that provides authorization decisions or tokens.
fulfiller FulfillerAn actor (often human) that performs the action requested by the interaction.
validator ValidatorAn actor that validates content or identity during the interaction.
